condition.statement: bowel obstruction or bowel perforation is reported

planted.grammar: RULE WHEN [findings: bowel obstruction or bowel perforation is reported] SUPPRESS NEGATIVES
planted.evidence: 03 (small bowel obstruction) and 04 (perforated diverticulitis) drop the paragraph's normal-calibre / no bowel wall thickening wording entirely and describe the bowel from the finding. Contrast 02 (uncomplicated appendicitis: neither obstruction nor perforation) which keeps no bowel wall thickening or inflammatory change for the remaining bowel, and 01/05 which use the full normal paragraph.

condition.statement: an acute bowel or appendiceal abnormality is reported

planted.grammar: RULE WHEN [findings: an acute bowel or appendiceal abnormality is reported] ORDER FIRST
planted.evidence: In 02 (appendicitis), 03 (SBO) and 04 (diverticulitis) the bowel paragraph opens FINDINGS, before the hepatobiliary paragraph. In 01 (normal) and 05 (ureteric calculus, a non-bowel abnormality left in its usual renal-tract position) the bowel paragraph sits fourth.

expected_per_dictation.notes: Perforated duodenal ulcer: bowel perforation (P19 suppresses the bowel paragraph negatives; the paragraph is written around the duodenal perforation, remaining bowel described as normal calibre from the dictation), acute bowel abnormality (P20 places the bowel paragraph first), free intraperitoneal gas (P21 replaces the negative with Free intraperitoneal gas as described above.). No free fluid or collection. is contradicted by moderate free fluid; a No collection. clause may be kept. Conclusion numbered, ending Recommend urgent surgical review.
Normal study: all NORMAL paragraphs in standard order, conclusion as example 01 (No CT evidence of appendicitis. / No acute abdominal or pelvic abnormality.).

negatives_omitted: No periappendiceal collection or extraluminal gas to suggest perforation.
no bowel wall thickening or inflammatory change
expected_per_dictation.notes: Tricky: perforated appendicitis with abscess. The IF_PRESENT negative learnt from example 02 for appendicitis (No periappendiceal collection or extraluminal gas...) must flip to OMIT because the dictation reports both. Extraluminal gas is localised, and the dictation states no free intraperitoneal gas, so P21 must NOT fire and No free intraperitoneal gas. stands. P19 is met by reading a perforated appendix as bowel perforation (the examples never show a perforated appendix; a brief that keeps the bowel negatives here is a judgement miss, not a grammar miss). Terminal ileal thickening also contradicts the bowel negative independently. Reactive nodes contradict No lymphadenopathy.
